gpt-4o-mini.title: The Last of the President's Men
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A compelling narrative about the life of H.R. Haldeman and his role in the Nixon presidency.

gemma2:9b.explanation: Explores Trump's presidency through interviews and firsthand accounts, highlighting his volatile personality and impact on the nation.

gemma2:9b.explanation: A comprehensive reexamination of the Watergate scandal, drawing on newly uncovered documents and interviews with key figures.
